description: VOIRIE DGF is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Institut national de l'information géographique et forestière. VOIRIE DGF A partir de 2025, l’article 178 de la loi de finances n°2025-127, codifié à l’article L 2334-22 du CGCT, modifie l’assiette et les modalités de recensement de la voirie utilisées pour le calcul de la Dotation Globale de Fonctionnement (DGF) des communes et des départements. Coverage: Institut national de l'information géographique et forestière. The publisher named on the listing is Institut national de l'information géographique et forestière. Its keywords include topographie, dgcl, dsr, inspire, reseaux-de-transport, routes. The listing shows 6 download or service links in WMS, WFS, WMTS. The listing shows 2026-06-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
